It does not accept every later working copy. This candidate is identified by fresh input/output SHA-256 records in [review evidence](evidence/model-consistency-review-2026-11-01.json); the prior report’s HEAD is not asserted as current. No new M-02/M-03 or analysis/design acceptance decision is recorded. **Review boundary:** all current structured source inventories, source-identity/association checks, current rule partitions, state reachability, activity structural termination and selected documentary criterion/model boundaries. Source scope includes Planning, Requirements Engineering and System Analysis; current report/navigation targets are identified separately. No code, live server, provider API, load/security control, backup restore or product workflow was executed.
